stories.title: Au sud du Liban, le sort des villages isolés dépend du maintien de la mission onusienne

en.title: In southern Lebanon, the fate of isolated villages depends on maintaining the UN mission
en.summary: Southern Lebanese border villages in territory occupied by Israeli forces since March face uncertain futures as the UN interim force in Lebanon approaches its end-of-year expiration, with some communities relying on its presence.

stories.title: Les lauriers scientifiques suisses vont à une mathématicienne et un biochimiste

en.title: Swiss scientific honours go to a mathematician and a biochemist
en.summary: A mathematician who solved a long-standing geometry problem and a co-inventor of genetic scissors are awarded Switzerland's prestigious Latsis and Marcel Benoist scientific prizes.

stories.title: A la découverte d’une Lausanne de verre et en noir et blanc au Musée historique de la ville

en.title: Discovering a glass and black-and-white Lausanne at the city's historical museum
en.summary: An exhibition at the Lausanne historical museum features 19th-century glass negatives by photographer André Schmid documenting the city and its inhabitants, combined with contemporary artworks exploring memory and rediscovery.

stories.title: Kulturnews in Kurzform – Kalifornien lanciert «Dolly Parton Day»

en.title: Culture news in brief – California launches "Dolly Parton Day"
en.summary: California, Nashville, Portland and other locations honour the country music legend with a dedicated day.

stories.title: TeddyBear, la nouvelle révélation belge qui "ne calcule rien"

en.title: TeddyBear, the new Belgian revelation who "calculates nothing"
en.summary: TeddyBear, a 24-year-old singer from Mons, has quickly become a prominent figure in Belgian pop music with his song 'Chaussures roses', which has garnered nearly 1.5 million YouTube views. He recently performed at major summer festivals and has announced the release of his debut album.

en.title: UBS reaches settlement in Dutch legacy Credit Suisse matter
en.summary: UBS has reached an agreement regarding an outstanding Dutch matter related to Credit Suisse.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Russland greift mehrere Städte an – mindestens vier Tote

en.title: War in Ukraine – Russia attacks multiple cities – at least four dead
en.summary: Russian forces attacked several Ukrainian cities, with at least four people killed and six wounded in Dnipro, according to the regional governor.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – G7-Länder verurteilen Angriffe der Huthi-Miliz

en.title: War in the Middle East – G7 countries condemn Houthi militia attacks
en.summary: Group of Seven nations have denounced the violent actions of the Iran-backed Houthi militia against Saudi Arabia and in Yemen.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Iran-Krieg: Vermögen von iranischen Regimegegnern beschlagnahmt +++ Neue Angriffe auf Huthi-Stellungen in Jemen

en.title: LIVE TICKER - Iran War: Assets of Iranian regime opponents seized +++ New attacks on Houthi positions in Yemen
en.summary: The United States and Iran have been in a state of war since February 2026. Although they agreed to a ceasefire, Donald Trump declared it ended in early July. The ticker covers the latest developments.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Dnipro meldet mehrere Tote nach russischen Angriffen +++ Selenski fordert vor dem Treffen mit Trump erneut eine begrenzte Waffenruhe

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Dnipro reports multiple deaths after Russian attacks +++ Zelenskyy calls for limited ceasefire ahead of Trump meeting
en.summary: Russia has been waging war against Ukraine for over four years. The ticker provides an overview of the most important recent developments.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Gescheiterte Investorenpläne der Fifa: Infantino zeigt sich erstmals für Gespräche bereit – und kündigt Wandel an

en.title: LATEST DEVELOPMENTS - Failed FIFA investor plans: Infantino shows willingness for talks for the first time – and announces change
en.summary: FIFA planned to transfer some commercial rights to private investors but withdrew the proposal in early August. An overview addresses key questions and answers.

stories.title: Fifa-Präsident kämpft um Amt – Infantino zeigt sich offen für Dialog

en.title: FIFA president fights for position – Infantino shows openness to dialogue
en.summary: Gianni Infantino sent a letter to member associations expressing willingness to strengthen FIFA institutions through dialogue.

stories.title: In Zürich und Tokio droht die grösste Immobilienblase – Miami fällt zurück

en.title: Zurich and Tokyo face largest real estate bubbles – Miami falls back
en.summary: A real estate bubble index identifies Zurich and Tokyo as markets where home prices have increasingly diverged from local income growth, while Miami's risk ranking has declined.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Der Mut zur unbequemen Wahrheit: Die Kriegsverhinderung in Europa verlangt einen gemeinsamen Willensakt

en.title: COMMENT - The courage for uncomfortable truth: Preventing war in Europe requires a joint act of will
en.summary: Russia is intensifying attacks on European democracies. To protect freedom and open debate, authorities must clearly identify the threat, including in Switzerland.

stories.title: «Empörend» – «Ich finde es wichtig, dass auf die negativen Folgen der Regulierung hingewiesen wird»: Die Aussagen von Sergio Ermotti geben im Ständerat zu reden

en.title: "Outrageous" – "I think it's important to point out the negative consequences of regulation": Sergio Ermotti's statements spark debate in the Council of States
en.summary: Parliament will decide Wednesday on UBS's future capital requirements in a critical decision for the major bank. The bank's chief has strongly criticized the responsible authorities in recent remarks.

stories.title: Russland könnte die Nato schon bald testen, sagen westliche Geheimdienste. Während Europa in Alarmismus verfällt, sind es auf einmal die Balten, die beschwichtigen

en.title: Russia could soon test NATO, say Western intelligence agencies. While Europe descends into alarmism, it is suddenly the Baltic states that call for calm
en.summary: Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania warned about Russia when the rest of Europe was not paying attention. Now they are urging caution and restraint.
